name: intro_lets_go_v3
tags: upbeat cartoon theme song, happy pop rock, catchy, energetic, bright female and male vocals, group chorus, electric guitar, drums, 140 bpm, major key, fun, friendship
lyrics:
[intro]
Vroom, vroom! Here we go!

[verse]
Wheels are turning, engines humming,
All my friends, I hear you coming!
Big or small or fast or slow,
Together, come on, let's go!

[chorus]
Mega-Mega, MegaWheel Arena!
Never give up, we'll race forever!
Ding-ding-ding, the road is calling,
Get back up whenever you're falling!

[verse]
Through the bumps and splashing water,
Zippy, Buster, pushing harder!
Rocky jumps the giant holes,
We are heroes, watch us roll!

[outro]
Mega-Mega, MegaWheel Arena!
Best friends racing, now and ever!
MegaWheel... Arena!
